verdict.rationale: The evidence shows two separate options: running the Mastra server locally or self-deployed, or deploying the whole app to Mastra Cloud. Nothing describes a hybrid model where customer-hosted workers connect to a vendor-managed orchestration control plane while code and data stay in the customer network. Fully self-hosting is a different deployment model, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I run workers in my own infrastructure while the vendor manages the orchestration control plane — code and data stay inside my network
